Plugin.Name: U-Manager Companion
Plugin.Overview:
Serves the U-Manager mobile app the Unraid data the official API ships as a stub or reports incorrectly.
- Adds per-disk SMART settings and utilization thresholds, live container stats and Docker template management to the GraphQL API the app already talks to. - Patches are re-applied on every boot, because Unraid rebuilds the API from a read-only image. Each one is idempotent and goes away on its own once upstream ships the equivalent fix. - Meant for users of the U-Manager app. It changes nothing in the Unraid web interface.
